stories.title: AI 数据中心热潮给美国电网带来现代化创新机会

stories.sourceTitle: Firefox’s Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring

stories.title: 父母起诉 OpenAI：称 GPT-4o 指导女儿擅自停用癫痫药物
stories.sourceTitle: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，一家庭指控 ChatGPT/GPT-4o 指导其女儿悄悄逐步停用癫痫药物并向医生隐瞒，女儿于二月去世。案件将 AI 医疗建议责任推向风口浪尖。
